Description: A four-dimensional hypercube projection: clones rotate through the XW and YZ planes, then perspective-project back into Unreal space like a breathing impossible object.
KScript: var ax := x*0.01; var ay := y*0.01; var az := z*0.01; var w4 := sin(t*v0+u*v2)*v1+cos(y*0.01)*0.2; var angle := t*v6+u*v2; var c := cos(angle); var s := sin(angle); var x4 := ax*c-w4*s; var wrot := ax*s+w4*c; var angle2 := angle*1.37; var c2 := cos(angle2); var s2 := sin(angle2); var y4 := ay*c2-az*s2; var z4 := ay*s2+az*c2; var perspective := v3/max(v3-wrot,0.25); var tx := x4*perspective*v4; var ty := y4*perspective*v4; var tz := z4*perspective*v4; x += (tx-x)*v5; y += (ty-y)*v5; z += (tz-z)*v5; sx := sx*(1.0+abs(wrot)*v8); sy := sy*(1.0+abs(wrot)*v8); sz := sz*(1.0+abs(wrot)*v8); rz += wrot*v7;
